response.consequence: After the site default locale is changed, users whose locale lacks a translation can keep getting strings in the previous default language until the cache is reset or the process restarts. Lookups outside controller requests can also fall through to the key or a "translation missing" string.
response.explanation: The fallback chain is now [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en], so it depends on a site setting that admins can change at runtime. The LRU cache key in translate is only "#{key}#{config.locale}#{backend.object_id}". Take a locale such as fr whose translation for a key is missing. Its fallback result is cached under the key for fr. If the admin then changes default_locale, the cache entry still holds the value resolved from the old default locale. The cache is not cleared on that change, and reload! is the only thing that resets it. In addition, translate loads only config.locale and never the fallback locales. Callers outside set_locale, such as jobs and mailers using I18n.with_locale, never call ensure_loaded!, so their fallback lookups can resolve to a locale that is not loaded.
response.title: Translation cache key ignores the dynamic site-default fallback locale
